against_battery.miscalibration: EVIDENCE AGAINST if, for ANY width with >= min_informative_items informative items, the stream has >= against_min_days matured freeze days, |gap| >= against_min_abs_gap, and the against_ci block-bootstrap interval of gap excludes 0. gap > 0 = bands broke MORE often than forecast.

fixed_rule.cadence: One verdict every 28 days on the CUMULATIVE matured record since the first freeze. Earlier verdicts are never revised.
calibrated_conditions_all_required: for EVERY width with >= min_informative_items informative items: the calibrated_ci block-bootstrap interval of gap lies entirely inside [-calibration_tolerance, +calibration_tolerance]
at least one width saw both outcomes among its informative items
fixed_rule.evaluation_order: INVALID first; then EVIDENCE AGAINST; then CALIBRATED; else UNTESTED. The first that fires decides.
fixed_rule.forecast_object: p = P(breach within 14 days) for a fresh band +/-5%, +/-15%, +/-35% around the pool's own price, snapped OUTWARD to the pool's tick spacing, for every pool in avax_v2/universe.json (Avalanche concentrated-liquidity pools - Uniswap v3 and Pharaoh - fixed at seal; the file's sha256 is in every row). Frozen once per UTC day at 14:40 UTC from the latest collector sample (<= 15 min old). Three labelled models: AV-B1 = the asset's Coinbase daily candles (AVAX, ETH, BTC); AV-B1-x = AVAX-quoted cross pools, the daily ratio series from hourly closes (understates intraday extremes slightly); AV-B1-own = pools with no candle series, from this collector's own daily closes. A pool is forecast only once it has 60 usable 14-day windows; until then it is published as 'collecting history' and given no number.
invalid_battery: any frozen row created after its window opened (window_start_ts != created_at_ts) or whose entry sample is more than 900 s older than created_at_ts
a matured row is INCOMPLETE when its window has < 90% of the expected ~5-minute samples; INCOMPLETE rows exceeding incomplete_max_share of the stream's matured rows make the verdict INVALID
the stream froze on fewer than running_min_share of the calendar days in the judged period
any row whose prediction_hash does not recompute from its own fields
fixed_rule.outcome: breach = 1 if ANY collector sample (one per ~5 minutes) with created_at_ts <= ts < created_at_ts + 14 d has tick < band_tick_lower OR tick >= band_tick_upper. 5-minute sampling can miss a brief excursion; that bias favours 'no breach' and is accepted, not corrected.

protocol_constants.gap_definition: gap(width) = mean over resolved items of (breach - p)
protocol_constants.informative_item: an item with 0.02 <= p <= 0.98 (near-certain forecasts are excluded from the tests but shown in the reliability table)

reported_not_gated: Brier and Brier skill vs climatology per width
gaps split BY PAIR CLASS (USD vs CROSS) and BY MODEL (AV-B1 / AV-B1-x / AV-B1-own)
fee_14d_est, exp_il and FIR are displayed economics and are NOT graded by this standard
fixed_rule.serial_dependence: Daily 14-day windows overlap and Avalanche pools move together (several are the same AVAX or ETH price at different fee tiers), so rows are NOT independent. All inference resamples whole freeze DAYS in moving blocks of 14 consecutive days (2000 resamples, seed 42).

notes: Seal BEFORE the first avax-v2.0.0 freeze. Spec: docs/design/AVAX_V2_SPEC.md. Trader Joe Liquidity Book pools hold most Avalanche liquidity but price in BINS, not ticks: they are listed on the board as not covered, with that reason, rather than forced into a tick band.
one_line_commitment: Every day, for every covered Avalanche CL pool and three band widths, a probability that price leaves the band within 14 days is frozen before the window opens; the cumulative record is judged mechanically on calibration, and every result is published including misses.
status: STANDING STANDARD (AVAX v2 / probability-of-breach family) - COMMITTED. Governs every avax-v2.0.0 forecast. Sealed before the first freeze.
